qe: Which statutory authority is responsible for regulating telecommunication tariffs, interconnections, and quality of service in India?
qh: भारत में दूरसंचार टैरिफ, इंटरकनेक्शन और सेवा की गुणवत्ता को नियंत्रित करने वाला वैधानिक प्राधिकरण कौन सा है?
o: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
e: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) ek statutory niyamak (regulator) hai jo Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997 ke teht bana - iska kaam telecom sevaon ke tarif (tariffs), operators ke beech interconnection (ek network se doosre network par call jaana), quality of service aur upbhokta (consumer) hito ki raksha ke niyam banane aur unhe lagu karane mein hai. CBI ek jaanch agency hai, NITI Aayog ek niti (policy) think-tank hai jiske paas niyamak shakti nahi hoti, aur SEBI share bazaar (securities market) ko niyantrit karta hai - telecom ka kaam nahi. Exam point: telecom ka niyamak = TRAI (1997 ka kanoon); SEBI = securities, RBI = banking, IRDAI = insurance.

qe: Does the jurisdiction of the Lokayukta of Bihar extend to all tiers of state bureaucracy from Group A to Group D?
qh: क्या बिहार लोकायुक्त का अधिकार क्षेत्र समूह A से समूह D तक के सभी राज्य प्रशासनिक अधिकारियों तक फैला हुआ है?
o: True, all public servants from Group A to Group D fall under its inquiry jurisdiction
Only non-gazetted contractual staff are covered
False, only Group D employees are investigated
Jurisdiction is strictly limited to Group A officers
e: Bihar Lokayukta ka kshetraadhikar (jurisdiction) rajya ke sabhi lok sevakon par hai - Group A, B, C aur D sabhi star ke adhikari aur karmachari iske daayre mein aate hain, aur mukhya mantri, mantri, vidhayak tatha adhyakshon par bhi jaanch ho sakti hai (kuchh apvaad chhod kar). Iska aadhar yahi hai ki bhrashtachar (corruption) kisi bhi star par ho sakta hai, isliye chhoti-badi naukri ka bhed nahi kiya jaata. Vikalp 'keval Group D' ya 'keval Group A' wali baatein galat hain kyunki Bihar Lokayukta Act ka daayra sabhi vargon par faila hua hai. Exam point: Bihar Lokayukta = Group A se D tak sabhi lok sevak uske daayre mein (upar ke padadhikariyon ke liye alag pravdhan bhi hain).

qe: Who presides over the National Statistical Commission (NSC) as its Chairperson?
qh: राष्ट्रीय सांख्यिकी आयोग (NSC) के अध्यक्ष के रूप में कौन कार्य करता है?
o: An eminent statistician or social scientist
The Governor of the Reserve Bank of India
e: Rashtriya Sankhyiki Aayog (National Statistical Commission - NSC) ke adhyaksh (Chairperson) koi prashiddh (eminent) sankhyiki-vid (statistician) ya samaj-vigyanik (social scientist) hote hain, na ki koi mantri ya sarkari adhikari - kyunki ye aayog desh ke aankde (data) aur sankhyiki vyavastha par nishpaksh (impartial) salah dene wali sanstha hai (2005 ki Rangarajan Committee ki sifarish par bani). Iske saath Bhartiya sankhyiki seva (Indian Statistical Service) aur NSO (National Statistical Office) ke kaam aate hain. Vitta mantri, pradhan mantri, RBI governor iske adhyaksh nahi hote; wo apne-apne kshetra ke padadhikari hain. Exam point: NSC ka adhyaksh = prashiddh sankhyik/samaj vigyanik; NSC data aur survey vyavastha par salah deti hai.

qe: Which statutory body regulates and supervises insurance and reinsurance businesses in India?
qh: भारत में बीमा और पुनर्बीमा व्यवसाय को कौन सा वैधानिक निकाय नियंत्रित और पर्यवेक्षित करता है?
o: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
e: Insurance aur reinsurance (bima aur punahbima) ke vyavsay ko niyantrit aur paryavekshit (supervise) karne wali statutory sanstha Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) hai, jo IRDA Act, 1999 ke teht bani; iska mukhyaalay Hyderabad mein hai aur ye policy-holder ke hito ki raksha, solvency (bhugtan kshmata) aur market ke vikas ko dekhti hai. RBI banking aur payment ka niyamak hai, SEBI securities bazaar ka aur PFRDA pension kshetra ka niyamak hai - ye teeno ke kaam bima se alag hain. Exam point: bima ka niyamak = IRDAI (1999); RBI = banking, SEBI = share market, PFRDA = pension.

qe: During its inquiries into anti-competitive practices, the Competition Commission of India (CCI) holds powers equivalent to which legal entity?
qh: प्रतिस्पर्धा विरोधी आचरण की जांच के दौरान भारतीय प्रतिस्पर्धा आयोग (CCI) के पास किस स्तर की शक्तियां होती हैं?
o: Arbitral body with non-binding recommendations only
A Civil Court under the Code of Civil Procedure for summoning persons and requisitioning public records
Criminal Sessions Court with power to issue warrants
e: Competition Commission of India (CCI) ko Competition Act, 2002 ke teht milik-vivad (anti-competitive practices) ki jaanch ke liye Civil Court ke samaan shaktiyan mili hain - iske tahat wo kisi bhi vyakti ko haazir (summon) kar sakti hai, dastavez (documents) aur public record talab kar sakti hai, shapath-patra (affidavit) lekar sakshya (evidence) le sakti hai aur bina aadhaar (person) ke pratinidhitva ke saamne aiya (proceedings) chala sakti hai. Lekin ye koi criminal sessions court nahi hai jise giraftari warrant mila ho, na ye koi vidhayak (legislative) sanstha hai jo decree jaari kare - uske aadesh nyayik samiksha (appeal) ke liye COMPAT/NCLAT ke paas ja sakte hain. Exam point: CCI ki jaanch ki shakti = civil court ke barabar (Competition Act, 2002), par wo criminal court nahi hai.

qe: From which authority does the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) draw its operational budgetary grants?
qh: राष्ट्रीय मानवाधिकार आयोग (NHRC) अपना परिचालन बजटीय अनुदान किस प्राधिकरण से प्राप्त करता है?
e: NHRC (National Human Rights Commission) ko apne kharch-chalane ke liye dhan (grants) kendra sarkar se milta hai, jo sansad (Parliament) dwara varshik viniyog (appropriations) ke through paas hota hai - kyunki NHRC ek statutory body hai jo Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 ke teht bani aur use kendra sarkar ka anudan (grant-in-aid) milta hai. Supreme Court registry, Delhi rajya ki Consolidated Fund ya videshi (foreign) daan iske aadhar nahi hain; NHRC videshi chanda par nirbhar nahi hoti, isliye use 'sarkari paisa' milta hai bhale hi wo swatantra (independent) sanstha hai. Exam point: NHRC ki funding = kendra sarkar (sansad ke viniyog se) - PHR Act, 1993.

qe: Which agency was initially entrusted with monitoring anti-profiteering matters under GST before the mandate was transferred to the CCI?
qh: GST के तहत मुनाफाखोरी रोधी मामलों की निगरानी का दायित्व CCI को सौंपे जाने से पहले किस एजेंसी को दिया गया था?
o: Goods and Services Tax Council Secretariat
Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)
e: GST ke teht adhik laabh (anti-profiteering) rokne ke liye sabse pehle National Anti-Profiteering Authority (NAA) ka gthan hua tha, jo ye dekh ti thi ki GST dar (rate) ghata hone ka laabh upbhokta ko pahuncha ya nahi - iske aadesh (2017 se) ke baad jab iska karyakal khatm hua to ye mamla Competition Commission of India (CCI) ke paas chala gaya. SFIO company fraud dekh ti hai, GST Council ek niyam-banane wali sanstha hai (jismein centre aur rajya ke vitta mantri hote hain), aur CBIC GST wasooli (collection) dekhta hai. Exam point: GST anti-profiteering = pehle NAA, baad mein CCI ko mandate - kyunki profiteering bhi ek competition (mukabla) ka sawaal hai.

qe: Who is generally designated as the Chief Vigilance Officer (CVO) within a Union Ministry?
qh: केंद्रीय मंत्रालय में आमतौर पर मुख्य सतर्कता अधिकारी (CVO) के रूप में किसे नामित किया जाता है?
o: A senior administrative officer (Joint Secretary level) appointed with CVC concurrence
A judicial magistrate appointed by the High Court
e: Kendra ke kisi bhi mantralaya ya vibhag mein Chief Vigilance Officer (CVO) ke roop mein aam taur par ek senior prashasnik adhikari (Joint Secretary level) ko niyukt kiya jaata hai, aur is niyukti par Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) ki sahmati (concurrence) leni hoti hai - taaki vigyapanik (vigilance) vyavastha ki swatantrata bani rahe. CVO mantralaya ke bhitar bhrashtachar (corruption) ke muddon ki jaanch karata hai aur CVC ko report deta hai. Nyayik adhikari (judicial magistrate), bahari auditor ya rajya police ka adhikari CVO nahi ban sakta, kyunki CVO ka kaam andar ki jaanch hai, kisi crime ki FIR nahi. Exam point: CVO = ministry ka senior prashasnik adhikari, CVC ki concurrence se niyukt.

qe: The Lokayukta of Bihar is appointed by the Governor upon the formal recommendation of a committee headed by:
qh: बिहार के लोकायुक्त की नियुक्ति राज्यपाल द्वारा किसकी अध्यक्षता वाली समिति की सिफारिश पर की जाती है?
o: The Speaker of the Legislative Assembly
The Chief Justice of the Patna High Court
e: Bihar Lokayukta ki niyukti Rajyapal (Governor) karte hain, lekin ye niyukti ek chayan samiti (selection committee) ki sifarish par hoti hai jiski adhyakshta mukhya mantri (Chief Minister) karte hain; is samiti mein Vidhan Sabha ke Adhyaksh, Vidhan Sabha mein vipaksh ka neta aur vidhan parishad wale adhikari bhi shaamil hote hain, aur chayan mein Patna High Court ke Mukhya Nyayadhish ki bhi rsay hoti hai. 'Vipaksh ka neta' ya 'Speaker' is samiti ke sadasya hote hain, adhyaksh nahi; uchchatam nyayalay ka koi role nahi hota. Exam point: Bihar Lokayukta = Rajyapal dwara niyukti, mukhya mantri ki adhyakshta wali chayan samiti ki sifarish par.

qe: Which national law enforcement agency is empowered to investigate counterfeit currency offences having transnational linkages?
qh: अंतरराष्ट्रीय संबंधों वाले जाली नोट अपराधों की जांच के लिए कौन सी राष्ट्रीय कानून प्रवर्तन एजेंसी अधिकृत है?
o: Reserve Bank of India Enforcement Cell
Both National Investigation Agency (NIA) and Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)
e: Jaali note (counterfeit currency) ke aise mamlon ki jaanch jismein bideshi (transnational) ang bhi ho, usmein National Investigation Agency (NIA) aur Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) dono ki bhoomika aati hai - NIA Act, 2008 ke teht FICN (Fake Indian Currency Notes) se juda aapraadh 'schedule offence' hai, isliye NIA ise jaanch sakti hai; saath hi CBI bhi rajya sarkar ki sehmati se ya High Court/Supreme Court ke aadesh par ise jaanch ti hai. RBI ka 'Enforcement Cell' jaise koi ank ho nahi hai jo aisa aapraadh jaanche (RBI currency ke prabandhan ka kaam dekhta hai). Exam point: jaali note ke mamle (bideshi jude) = NIA + CBI dono; NIA Act ke schedule mein FICN shaamil hai.

qe: Is NITI Aayog subject to the provisions and disclosures mandated by the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005?
qh: क्या नीति आयोग सूचना का अधिकार (RTI) अधिनियम, 2005 के प्रावधानों और प्रकटीकरणों के अधीन है?
o: Applicable strictly to state planning boards only
Yes, as it is a public authority constituted and financed by the Central Government
Exempted indefinitely under Section 24 of the RTI Act
No, because it holds constitutional immunity
e: NITI Aayog RTI (Right to Information) Act, 2005 ke daayre mein aati hai, kyunki wo ek public authority hai - kendra sarkar ne use banayi hai, uska kharch kendra sarkar ke bhandaar (budget) se hota hai, aur uske paas adhikari aur record hote hain. Section 24 ke teht khaas soochna (intelligence/security) sansthaon ko chhoot milti hai, aur NITI Aayog us soochi mein nahi hai; iske alava samvidhanik (constitutional) immunities kisi executive body ko nahi milti. Haan, rajya ke planning boards bhi apne-apne sthaan par RTI ke daayre mein ho sakte hain. Exam point: NITI Aayog = RTI ke daayre mein aane wali public authority (Section 24 ki chhoot wali soochi mein nahi).

qe: Under which regulatory framework are Micro-Finance Institutions (NBFC-MFIs) supervised in India?
qh: भारत में माइक्रो-फाइनेंस संस्थान (NBFC-MFIs) किस विनियामक ढांचे के तहत पर्यवेक्षित किए जाते हैं?
o: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
e: Micro-Finance Institutions (NBFC-MFIs) ka niyamak (regulator) Reserve Bank of India (RBI) hai - kyunki ye non-banking financial companies hain jo NBFC-MFI ke roop mein RBI se registration lete hain aur RBI ki 'Master Directions' ke hisaab se kaam karte hain (jaise loan ka aakaar, interest ki ginti, income seema wale grahitaon ke hit). NABARD inke liye refinance ya vikas ka sahyog kar sakta hai, par niyamak nahi; SEBI securities ka niyamak hai aur Gramin Vikas Mantralaya (Ministry of Rural Development) schemes chalata hai. Exam point: NBFC-MFI = RBI ke daayre mein (NBFC ke roop mein registered); NABARD = refinance sahyog.

qe: Under the Right to Information Act, 2005, the Central Information Commission (CIC) can have at most how many Information Commissioners besides the Chief Information Commissioner?
qh: सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम, 2005 के तहत केंद्रीय सूचना आयोग (CIC) में मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त के अलावा अधिकतम कितने सूचना आयुक्त हो सकते हैं?
e: RTI Act, 2005 ke Section 12(2) ke anusaar Central Information Commission (CIC) mein Mukhya Soochna Aayukta (Chief Information Commissioner) ke saath 10 se adhik Information Commissioners nahi ho sakte - yani kul aakaar 11 tak ho sakta hai (1 CIC + 10 IC). 2019 ke RTI sanshodhan (amendment) ne aayuktaon ki seva-shart (tenure aur salary) ko sarkar dwara tay karne ki baat kahi, lekin sadasyaon ki sankhya ki chhat (ceiling) wahi rahi. 12, 5 ya 'no ceiling' wale vikalp kanoon ke aankdon se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: CIC = 1 Chief + adhiktam 10 Information Commissioners (Section 12(2)).

qe: Which statutory authority acts as the nodal agency for laying down science-based food standards and regulating food hygiene in India?
qh: भारत में विज्ञान-आधारित खाद्य मानक निर्धारित करने और खाद्य स्वच्छता को विनियमित करने के लिए कौन सा वैधानिक प्राधिकरण नोडल एजेंसी के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
e: Bharat mein khaadya (food) ke vigyapanik manak (science-based standards) tay karne aur khaadya swachchhata (hygiene) ko niyantrit karne wali statutory sanstha Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) hai, jo Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 ke teht bani aur Swasthya aur Parivaar Kalyan Mantralaya (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare) ke aadhin hai. ICAR krishi (agriculture) research karta hai, Upbhokta Mamlon ka mantralaya upbhokta hito ki niti dekhta hai, aur NITI Aayog ki agri-cell salahkaar hai - koi bhi niyamak nahi. Exam point: khaadya manak aur hygiene ka niyamak = FSSAI (2006), sehat mantralaya ke aadhin.

qe: Under the NIA Act, 2008, how is the tenure of the Director-General of the National Investigation Agency determined?
qh: NIA अधिनियम, 2008 के तहत राष्ट्रीय जांच एजेंसी के महानिदेशक का कार्यकाल कैसे निर्धारित किया जाता है?
o: Appointed strictly until the age of 65 years
Determined by a panel of High Court Chief Justices
As prescribed by the Central Government under operational rules
e: NIA Act, 2008 ke anusaar National Investigation Agency (NIA) ke Maha-Nideshak (Director-General) ki niyukti aur unka karyakal (tenure) kendra sarkar (Central Government) dwara niyamon ke teht tay kiya jaata hai - samvidhan mein 65 saal ki koi khud ki seema NIA DG ke liye likhi nahi hai, na koi mulk ki tarah '5 saal' ka fix aankda hai, aur High Court ke nyayadhishon ka panel is niyukti mein nahi hai. Vaise hi CBI ke nideshak ki niyukti ke liye alag chayan samiti hoti hai (PM vah LoP + CJI), par NIA DG ke liye niyam kendra sarkar tay karti hai. Exam point: NIA DG ka karyakal = kendra sarkar dwara niyamon se tay (NIA Act, 2008); CBI Director ke liye alag selection committee.

qe: Can the Lokayukta of Bihar inquire into corruption allegations against former Ministers of the State Government?
qh: क्या बिहार के लोकायुक्त राज्य सरकार के पूर्व मंत्रियों के खिलाफ भ्रष्टाचार के आरोपों की जांच कर सकते हैं?
o: Only if the Chief Minister gives prior cabinet sanction
No, only currently serving ministers can be investigated
Only after an inquiry by the State Assembly Ethics Committee
Yes, provided the complaint falls within the statutory limitation period of 5 years
e: Bihar Lokayukta poorv (former) mantriyon ke khilaf bhi bol (complaint) ki jaanch kar sakta hai, unke karyakal (term) ke doran ki karyavahi ka aakalan bhi ho sakta hai - lekin aise mamlon mein vidhan dwara tay samay-seema (limitation) ke andar shikayat aani chahiye, aur ye jaanch tab shuru hoti hai jab mudda uski sima mein aata ho; isse neta (leader) ke karyakal ke baad bhi jawabdehi (accountability) bani rehti hai. Mukhya mantri ya vidhan sabha ke saanvidhanik (prior) sangthan ki anumati lena zaroori nahi hai, aur koi 'keval karyaman (serving) mantri' jaisa niyam nahi hai. Exam point: Bihar Lokayukta = poorv mantriyon ki bhi jaanch kar sakta hai (vidhan/lokayukta Act ki limitation ke saath).

qe: Which body develops the 'SDG India Index' to measure the progress of States and UTs on sustainable development targets?
qh: सतत विकास लक्ष्यों पर राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों की प्रगति को मापने के लिए 'SDG इंडिया इंडेक्स' कौन सा निकाय विकसित करता है?
o: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
e: NITI Aayog 'SDG India Index' ko vikasit karta hai, jisse rajyaon aur sangha kshetraon (UTs) ke sustainable development goals (SDG) par ki gayi pragati (progress) ko aankna (measure) kiya jaata hai - ismein 13-17 soochak (indicators) hote hain jo rajyaon ka score banate hain, taaki sehat, shiksha, gareebi, ling samaan (gender equality) jaise kshetraon mein kaun aage hai ye pata chale. Sankhyiki aur karyakram kaaryanvayan mantralaya (MoSPI) aankdon (data) jama karta hai, lekin index NITI Aayog banata hai; NHRC manvadhikar aur Vitta Aayog (Finance Commission) vittiya hastantaran (devolution) dekhte hain. Exam point: SDG India Index = NITI Aayog (MoSPI data ke saath mil kar).

qe: What is the legal classification of the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)?
qh: पेंशन निधि विनियामक और विकास प्राधिकरण (PFRDA) का कानूनी वर्गीकरण क्या है?
o: An advisory wing of the Reserve Bank of India
A Statutory Regulatory Body established by an Act of Parliament
A Constitutional Body under Part XII of the Constitution
e: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) ek statutory niyamak sanstha hai jise Parliament ke kanoon - PFRDA Act, 2013 - ne bank bank (constituted) kiya; iska kaam National Pension System (NPS) aur Atal Pension Yojana jaise pension utpaadon (products) ka niyamian, pension fund managers ka panjikaran aur grahita (subscriber) hito ki suraksha hai. Ye koi private trust, RBI ka wing ya samvidhanik sanstha (constitutional body) nahi hai - samvidhanik sansthaon ki soochi mein Election Commission, CAG, UPSC jaise hi aate hain. Exam point: PFRDA = PFRDA Act, 2013 se bani statutory regulatory body (pension kshetra); samvidhanik sanstha nahi.

qe: Who appoints the Chairperson of the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB)?
qh: केंद्रीय प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड (CPCB) के अध्यक्ष की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
o: Union Minister of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
The Prime Minister in ex-officio capacity
The Central Government, nominating a person with specialized knowledge in environmental protection
e: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) ke Adhyaksh (Chairperson) ki niyukti kendra sarkar (Central Government) karti hai aur uske liye aise vyakti ko chuna jaata hai jise paryavaran (environment) sambandhi jaan ho (specialized knowledge) - CPCB ek statutory sanstha hai jo Water Act, 1974 aur Air Act, 1981 ke teht kaam karti hai aur rajya pradushan nigam (State Pollution Control Boards) ke saath mil kar pradushan ke manak aur nigrani karti hai. Rashtriya Hari Adalat (NGT) adhyaksh, kendra ka paryavaran mantri ya pradhan mantri CPCB ke chairperson nahi hote. Exam point: CPCB chairperson = kendra sarkar dwara niyukt, paryavaran ke visheshagy; CPCB rajya boards ke saath niyantran (coordination) karta hai.

qe: Does the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) have its own investigative cadre under statute?
qh: क्या राष्ट्रीय मानवाधिकार आयोग (NHRC) के पास कानून के तहत अपना स्वयं का जांच संवर्ग है?
o: It is restricted to evaluating judicial court records only
Yes, it has an autonomous investigation division headed by a Director General of Police
It must outsource all field verifications to private agencies
No, it must rely solely on regular state police reports
e: NHRC (National Human Rights Commission) ke paas Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 ke teht apni jaanch vyavastha (investigation division) hai jiski adhyakshta ek Maha-Nideshak (Director-General of Police) star ke adhikari karte hain, aur zarurat par wo CBI ya kisi anya jaanch agency se sahyog le sakta hai; isliye ye mansik (sirf) nyayik record dekhne tak seemit nahi hai, aur usse bahari (outsource) karne ka koi takaaza nahi hai (jaisa galat vikalp kehta hai). Haan, ye apne aap koi aapraadhik jaanch (criminal investigation) nahi karta - wo uski sifarish (recommendation) hoti hai. Exam point: NHRC = apni jaanch (investigation) vyavastha rakhata hai, uski adhyakshta DGP-rank adhikari karta hai.

qe: Which attached office under the Department of Pharmaceuticals regulates the ceiling prices of essential medicines in India?
qh: फार्मास्यूटिकल्स विभाग के तहत कौन सा कार्यालय भारत में आवश्यक दवाओं के अधिकतम मूल्य को नियंत्रित करता है?
e: Essenshal (essential) dawaon ki chhat (ceiling) keemtaun ko niyantrit karne wali kendra ki attached sanstha National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) hai, jo Rasayan aur Khad (Fertilizer) Mantralaya ke dawa vibhag (Department of Pharmaceuticals) ke aadhin kaam karti hai aur Drugs (Prices Control) Order ke teht dawa ke daam tay karti hai. CDSCO dawa ki gunwatta (quality) aur clinical trials dekhta hai, Pharmacy Council of India pharmacist ki pad (registration) dekhti hai, aur NHA (National Health Authority) Ayushman Bharat chalati hai - ye sab daam tay nahi karte. Exam point: dawaon ka daam/ceiling = NPPA (Department of Pharmaceuticals ke aadhin), gunwatta = CDSCO.

qe: The Zonal Council for the Eastern Zone (comprising Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Odisha) is chaired by:
qh: पूर्वी क्षेत्र के लिए क्षेत्रीय परिषद (जिसमें बिहार, झारखंड, पश्चिम बंगाल और ओडिशा शामिल हैं) की अध्यक्षता किसके द्वारा की जाती है?
e: Purvi (Eastern) Zonal Council - jismein Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal aur Odisha shaamil hain - ki adhyakshta (chairmanship) kendra ke Grih Mantri (Union Home Minister) karte hain, aur iske sadasya raajyaon ke mukhya mantri aur pradhan mantri ke pratinidhi hote hain; kendra ke Grih Mantralaya ke teht ye zonal councils rajyaon ke beech samanvay (coordination) aur aapsi vivad (inter-state disputes) ke hal ke liye kaam karte hain. Mukhya mantri inke 'Vice-Chairman' ki tarah hote hain (rotation), aur Rajyapal ya PM council ke adhyaksh nahi hote. Exam point: zonal councils = Grih Mantri adhyakshta, mukhya mantri vice-chairman (Bihar purvi zonal council mein aata hai).

qe: Which executive body serves as the national agency for coordinating responses to cyber incidents and vulnerabilities in India?
qh: भारत में साइबर घटनाओं और कमजोरियों के समाधान के समन्वय के लिए राष्ट्रीय एजेंसी के रूप में कौन सा निकाय कार्य करता है?
e: CERT-In (Indian Computer Emergency Response Team) cyber ghatnaon (incidents) aur suraksha chhidra (vulnerabilities) se juda raashtriya samanvay (coordination) agency hai, jise Soochana Praudyogiki (IT) Act, 2000 ke Section 70B ke teht jaari kiya gaya hai aur ye MeitY ke aadhin kaam karta hai - cyber hamla hone par soochit karne, sahayata dene aur sujhav (guidelines) jaari karne ka kaam isi ka hai. DCyA sipahi (military) kshetra ki cyber agency hai, NCCC antarik (internal) nigrani (monitoring) karta hai, aur CBI ek jaanch agency hai - ye teeno CERT-In ka kaam nahi karte. Exam point: cyber incidents ka national coordination = CERT-In (IT Act ka Section 70B, MeitY ke aadhin).

qe: What is the statutory limit on monetary penalties that the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) can directly levy on guilty individuals?
qh: राष्ट्रीय मानवाधिकार आयोग (NHRC) दोषी व्यक्तियों पर सीधे कितना मौद्रिक जुर्माना लगा सकता है?
o: Up to Rs. 25,000 per violation day
Zero; it lacks direct punitive or penal powers and functions in a recommendatory capacity
e: NHRC ke paas dand (penalty) lagane ki seedhi (direct) shakti nahi hai - wo ek salahkaar (recommendatory) sanstha hai jo jaanch ke baad sarkar ya adhikariyon ko sujhav (recommendations) deti hai, jaise peedit ko muavza (compensation) dilana, karyavahi shuru karana ya vishleshan (disciplinary action) ki sifarish. Ye shakti apni 'danda' shakti se nahi, balki lok (public) dabav aur sansad/rajya vidhan mandal ki karyavahi se chalati hai; isliye 'Rs 1 lakh', 'Rs 5 lakh' ya 'per day 25,000' jaise aankde NHRC ke paas nahi hain (aise aankde anya pravdhanon mein ho sakte hain). Exam point: NHRC ek recommendatory (salahkar) sanstha hai - uske paas khud ke aankdon mein dand lagane ki shakti nahi.

qe: Which administrative department functions as the nodal policy-making body for administering the Right to Information Act, 2005?
qh: सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम, 2005 के प्रशासन के लिए कौन सा प्रशासनिक विभाग नोडल नीति-निर्माण निकाय के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT), Ministry of Personnel
e: RTI Act, 2005 ke karyakram (administrative) aur niti-nirman (policy) ka nodal department Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT) hai, jo Karmik, Lok Shikayat aur Pension Mantralaya (Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions) ke aadhin aata hai - RTI ke niyam banane, soochna aayuktaon (Information Commissioners) ki niyukti ki prakriya aur RTI ke prashikshan (training) ki vyavastha yehi karta hai. CIC registry keval aayuktaon ke karyalay ka kaam dekhti hai, Vidhi aur Nyay Mantralaya kanoon ke masawde (drafts) par kaam kar sakta hai, aur Grih Mantralaya mukhya roop se andar ki suraksha dekhta hai. Exam point: RTI ka nodal department = DoPT (Ministry of Personnel); CIC ek quasi-judicial (apeal) sanstha hai.

qe: The Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO) derives its statutory investigative authority from which parent legislation?
qh: गंभीर धोखाधड़ी जांच कार्यालय (SFIO) अपनी वैधानिक जांच शक्ति किस कानून से प्राप्त करता है?
e: Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO) ki statutory jaanch shakti Companies Act, 2013 se aati hai - iske Section 212 ke teht SFIO kendra sarkar ke aadesh par badi kampaon ke gambhir dhokha (fraud) ki jaanch karti hai, uske paas summon, document japti (attachment) aur FIR darj karane jaise adhikar hote hain, aur iske nideshak ko police adhikari ke samaan shaktiyan mil sakti hain. DSPE Act, 1946 CBI ka aadhar hai, PMLA Enforcement Directorate ka aadhar hai, aur IBC diwaliya (insolvency) ki prakriya dekhta hai - ye teeno SFIO ke aadhar nahi hain. Exam point: SFIO = Companies Act, 2013 ke Section 212 ke teht jaanch agency (SFIO fraud ke mamlon mein), DSPE = CBI ka aadhar.

qe: The National Medical Commission (NMC) was constituted in 2020 by repealing which statutory institution?
qh: राष्ट्रीय चिकित्सा आयोग (NMC) का गठन 2020 में किस वैधानिक संस्थान को निरस्त करके किया गया था?
e: National Medical Commission (NMC) ko 2020 mein National Medical Commission Act, 2019 ke teht sthapit kiya gaya, jisne purane Medical Council of India (MCI) ko samapt (repeal) kar diya; MCI par varshon tak bhrashtachar aur adhoori nigrani ke aarop lage the, isliye NMC laakar chikitsa shiksha (medical education), doctoron ki padchinh (registration) aur etiksa (ethics) ke liye nayi vyavastha banaayi gayi. ICMR ek research sanstha hai, Dental Council daant ke doctoron ke liye thi/alag hai, aur Central Health Council koi anisi sanstha nahi hai. Exam point: NMC (2020) ne MCI ko hata kar pad (replaced) liya - NMC Act, 2019 ke teht.

qe: Can the Supreme Court of India dismiss or remove a nominated full-time member of NITI Aayog?
qh: क्या भारत का सर्वोच्च न्यायालय नीति आयोग के किसी पूर्णकालिक सदस्य को पद से हटा सकता है?
o: No, since NITI Aayog is an extra-constitutional executive body whose members serve at the discretion of the Union Government
Yes, through a writ of Quo Warranto
Only after an adverse finding by the Finance Commission
e: NITI Aayog ek extra-constitutional (samvidhan se bahar) karyapalika (executive) body hai, isliye uchchatam nyayalay uske nominated full-time sadasya ko hata nahi sakti - uske sadasya kendra sarkar ki marzi (discretion) se niyukt hote hain aur unka karyakal bhi sarkar tay karti hai. Article 317 wali jaanch UPSC/rajya lok seva aayog ke sadasyaon ke hataye ke liye hoti hai, Quo Warranto writ tabhi chalta hai jab pad samvidhanik ya kanooni ho aur us par koi ayogya (ineligible) vyakti baith gaya ho, aur Vitta Aayog (Finance Commission) to ek alag adhoc sanstha hai - ye teeno NITI Aayog par Laghu nahi hote. Exam point: NITI Aayog = extra-constitutional body, sadasya kendra sarkar ki marzi se (court unhe hata nahi sakti).

qe: Under the Competition Act, 2002, what is the maximum statutory strength of the Competition Commission of India (CCI)?
qh: प्रतिस्पर्धा अधिनियम, 2002 के तहत भारतीय प्रतिस्पर्धा आयोग (CCI) की अधिकतम वैधानिक संख्या क्या है?
e: Competition Act, 2002 ke anusaar Competition Commission of India (CCI) mein ek Adhyaksh (Chairperson) aur adhiktam 6 anya sadasya (Members) ho sakte hain - inmein adhiktam 2 nyayik sadasya (judicial members) hote hain jo High Court judge ke pad par pahunchne ki yogya hoon aur baaki anya kshetra (finance, economics, business) ke visheshagy hote hain. 6 ki sankhya baad me tab badi thi jab 2007 mein act sanshodhit hua, isliye '5 judicial members' ya '1+10' jaise aankde galat hain. Exam point: CCI = 1 Chairperson + 6 Members (Competition Act, 2002); CCI mein 2 tak judicial members ho sakte hain.

qe: Under the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR) mandate, a child is defined as any individual up to the age of:
qh: राष्ट्रीय बाल अधिकार संरक्षण आयोग (NCPCR) के तहत बच्चे को किस आयु वर्ग तक परिभाषित किया गया है?
e: National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR) ke karyadas (mandate) ke anusaar 'bal' (child) ki paribhasha 18 saal tak ki aayu wala vyakti hai - yahi vaishvik (global) sankalan aur Child Rights Convention (CRC) se mel khaati hai jise Bharat ne bhi sweekar kiya hai. NCPCR ek statutory sanstha hai jo Commission for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005 ke teht bani aur bal adhikaron ki raksha, bal shram (child labour) par rok aur bal kalyan yojnaon ki nigrani karti hai. 14, 16 ya 21 saal wale vikalp galat hain (14 saal bal shram se juda ek purana aankda hai, aur 21 saal kuchh aur pravdhanon mein aata hai). Exam point: NCPCR ke liye bal = 18 saal tak; NCPCR Act, 2005 se bani statutory sanstha.

qe: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) functions under which Union Ministry as an autonomous statutory authority?
qh: भारतीय विशिष्ट पहचान प्राधिकरण (UIDAI) किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय के तहत एक स्वायत्त वैधानिक प्राधिकरण के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
e: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) ek autonomous statutory authority hai jo Aadhaar Act, 2016 ke teht bani aur MeitY (Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology) ke aadhin kaam karti hai - Aadhaar ki kendra (enrolment), pramanikaran (authentication) aur suraksha (security) ki vyavastha isi ke paas hai. Isse pehle UIDAI yojana aayog (Planning Commission/NITI Aayog) ke aadhin thi, baad mein ise (2015 mein) MeitY ke paas bheja gaya, isliye vitta mantralaya, grih mantralaya ya 'Ministry of Planning' (jo ab nahi hai) wale vikalp galat hain. Exam point: UIDAI = Aadhaar Act, 2016 ki statutory authority, MeitY ke aadhin.

qe: Under Section 20(1) of the RTI Act, 2005, what is the maximum fine an Information Commission can impose on a defaulting Public Information Officer (PIO)?
qh: RTI अधिनियम, 2005 की धारा 20(1) के तहत सूचना आयोग किसी दोषी जन सूचना अधिकारी (PIO) पर अधिकतम कितना जुर्माना लगा सकता है?
o: Rs. 25,000 (calculated at Rs. 250 per day of default)
e: RTI Act, 2005 ke Section 20(1) ke anusaar soochna aayog (Information Commission) defaulting Public Information Officer (PIO) par adhiktam Rs 25,000 tak jurya (penalty) laga sakti hai, aur ye jurya Rs 250 prati din ke hisaab se lagti hai jab tak soochna nahi di jaati - iske alava aayog vishleshan (disciplinary) karyavahi ki bhi sifarish kar sakti hai. Isliye 'Rs 10,000', 'Rs 50,000' ya 'Rs 1,00,000' wale vikalp galat hain; 25,000 aur 250/din ka jodadi hi samvidhan mein likha hai. Exam point: RTI jurya = Rs 250 prati din, adhiktam Rs 25,000 (Section 20(1)); karyavahi ki sifarish Jan Samvarg (Section 20(2)) ke teht.

qe: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) traces its operational jurisdiction and police investigative powers to which enactment?
qh: केंद्रीय जांच ब्यूरो (CBI) अपने परिचालन अधिकार क्षेत्र और पुलिस जांच शक्तियों को किस कानून से प्राप्त करता है?
e: Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) apni police jaanch shaktiyan aur kshetraadhikar Delhi Special Police Establishment (DSPE) Act, 1946 se leti hai - ye kanoon British kaal mein dilli ke yuddh (war) aur videshi madad (procurement) ke MAMLE dekhne ke liye bana tha, aur aazadi ke baad 1963 mein isse CBI ka naam diya gaya. Indian Police Act, 1861 rajya police ke liye hai, CVC Act, 2003 CVC ki vyavastha hai, aur National Security Act, 1980 nirudan (detention) ka kanoon hai - inmein se koi CBI ka aadhar nahi hai. Exam point: CBI = DSPE Act, 1946 ke teht (police shaktiyan), isliye CBI ki jaanch ke liye rajya ki sehmati (consent) chahiye hoti hai.

qe: Who comprises the statutory selection committee for recommending the appointment of the Director of the CBI?
qh: CBI के निदेशक की नियुक्ति की सिफारिश करने वाली वैधानिक चयन समिति में कौन शामिल होता है?
o: Union Home Minister, Cabinet Secretary, and Central Vigilance Commissioner
President, Prime Minister, and Chief Justice of India
Prime Minister, Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha, and Chief Justice of India (or a nominated Supreme Court Judge)
e: CBI ke Nideshak (Director) ki niyukti ke liye jo chayan samiti (selection committee) hoti hai, usmein Pradhan Mantri (adhyaksh), Lok Sabha mein Vipaksh ka Neta (Leader of Opposition) aur Bhartiya uchchatam nyayalay ke Mukhya Nyayadhish ya unke dwara naamit koi sarvochch nyayadhish shaamil hote hain - isi samiti ki sifarish par niyukti hoti hai aur adhiktam 2 saal ka karyakal hota hai (kul 5 saal tak badhaya ja sakta hai). Grih Mantri, cabinet secretary, CVC ya koi sansadiya standing committee is samiti ka hissa nahi hai; yahi karan hai ki CBI ki niyukti ko swatantrata (autonomy) dene ke liye ye vipaksh ka pratinidhi bhi shaamil kiya gaya. Exam point: CBI Director = PM + Lok Sabha LoP + CJI/SC judge ki samiti; 2 saal ka karyakal (5 saal tak extension).

qe: Under the Central Vigilance Commission Act, 2003, what is the statutory tenure of the Central Vigilance Commissioner?
qh: केंद्रीय सतर्कता आयोग अधिनियम, 2003 के तहत केंद्रीय सतर्कता आयुक्त का कार्यकाल क्या होता है?
o: 4 years or until age 65, whichever is earlier
e: Central Vigilance Commission Act, 2003 ke anusaar Central Vigilance Commissioner ka karyakal (tenure) 4 saal ya 65 saal ki aayu - jo bhi pehle ho - hota hai, aur isi tarah anya aayuktaon ka bhi karyakal tay hota hai. 6 saal/65, 5 saal/65 ya 3 saal/70 wale vikalp galat hain; '4 years or until age 65' hi samvidhan ka aankda hai. CVC par 2003 ke kanoon se pehle koi statutory aadhar nahi tha (1998 se ek ordinance se chal raha tha), aur 2003 ke kanoon ne CVC ko ek bahu-sadasy (multi-member) sanstha banaya. Exam point: CVC ka karyakal = 4 saal ya 65 saal ki aayu (jo pehle), CVC Act 2003 ke teht niyukti rashtrapati dwara.

qe: Under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, who serves as the Executive Chairman of the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)?
qh: विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण अधिनियम, 1987 के तहत राष्ट्रीय विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण (NALSA) के कार्यकारी अध्यक्ष के रूप में कौन कार्य करता है?
o: The Chief Justice of India as Patron-in-Chief
The second senior-most Judge of the Supreme Court of India
The Union Minister of Law and Justice
e: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 ke anusaar National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) ke Executive Chairman kaa pad uchchatam nyayalay ke dusre sabse varishth (second senior-most) nyayadhish ke paas hota hai; Bhartiya uchchatam nyayalay ke Mukhya Nyayadhish NALSA ke Patron-in-Chief (sanrakshak) hote hain. Ye vyavastha isliye hai ki muft kaanooni sahayata (free legal aid) ko nyayapalika ka uchch (top) netritva mile. Attorney General kendra sarkar ka vidhik salahkar hai aur Vidhi Mantri is mamle mein executive hai - koi inmein NALSA ke executive chairman nahi hote. Exam point: NALSA = Patron-in-Chief CJI, Executive Chairman SC ke second senior-most nyayadhish (1987 ka kanoon).

qe: Under the RTI Act, 2005, what is the mandatory response window if the requested information concerns a citizen's 'Life or Liberty'?
qh: RTI अधिनियम, 2005 के तहत, यदि मांगी गई जानकारी किसी नागरिक के 'जीवन या स्वतंत्रता' से संबंधित है तो अनिवार्य समय-सीमा क्या है?
o: Within 48 hours of receipt of the request
e: RTI Act, 2005 ke Section 7(1) ke anusaar agar maangi gayi soochna kisi vyakti ke praan (life) ya swatantrata (liberty) se judi ho, to Lok Soochna Adhikari (PIO) ko 48 ghante ke andar jawab dena hota hai - samanya mamle mein ye samay 30 din ka hota hai. Isliye 24 ghante, 15 din ya 7 working days wale vikalp galat hain; 48 ghante ka samay ye dikhata hai ki jaan ka khatra ho to soochanaon ko praathamikta (priority) milti hai. Aur agar maang aspasht (vague) ho ya PIO ko soochana kisi doosri sanstha se leni ho to samay thoda badh sakta hai, par life/liberty wale mamle mein nahi. Exam point: life ya liberty ki soochna = 48 ghante ke andar (Section 7(1) ka proviso).

qe: The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) was originally conceived in 1964 upon the recommendations of which expert committee?
qh: केंद्रीय सतर्कता आयोग (CVC) की स्थापना मूल रूप से 1964 में किस विशेषज्ञ समिति की सिफारिशों पर की गई थी?
o: K. Santhanam Committee on Prevention of Corruption
e: Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) ki sthapna 1964 mein Santhanam Committee on Prevention of Corruption ki sifarish par hui - is committee ne dekha ki bhrashtachar rokne ke liye ek swatantra (independent) sanstha chahiye aur aise jaanch ko sarkari vibhagon se alag rakhna chahiye; iske baad 2003 mein kanoon banakar CVC ko statutory darja mila. A.D. Gorwala Committee (1951) prashasnik sudhar (reforms) ki report thi, Sarkaria Commission (1983) kendra-rajya sambandhon par thi, aur First Administrative Reforms Commission (1966) ne bhi prashasan par kaam kiya - par CVC ka janm Santhanam Committee se hi hua. Exam point: CVC = Santhanam Committee (1964) ki sifarish; CVC ko statutory darja 2003 mein.

qe: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) was established under a dedicated Act of Parliament following which major national security event?
qh: राष्ट्रीय जांच एजेंसी (NIA) की स्थापना किस प्रमुख राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा घटना के बाद संसद के एक अधिनियम के तहत की गई थी?
e: National Investigation Agency (NIA) ka gthan National Investigation Agency Act, 2008 ke teht 2008 ke Mumbai hamle (26/11) ke baad hua - us hamle ne dikhaya ki aatankvad (terrorism) ke mamle rajya ki sima (boundaries) se aage jaate hain aur ek kendra ki agency chahiye jo poore desh mein jaanch kar sake; isliye NIA ko aatankvad, FICN aur khaas aapraadhon ki jaanch ke liye 'special police establishment' jaisi shaktiyan mili. 1999 (Kargil), 2001 (sansad hamla - uske baad POTA aaya tha) aur 2016 (Pathankot) aise mauke the jinse alag nateeje/kanoon bane, par NIA ka aadhar 26/11 hi hai. Exam point: NIA = 26/11 (2008) Mumbai hamle ke baad, NIA Act 2008 ke teht.

qe: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) enforces which of the following principal economic enactments?
qh: प्रवर्तन निदेशालय (ED) निम्नलिखित में से किन प्रमुख आर्थिक कानूनों को लागू करता है?
o: Customs Act and Central Excise Tariff Act
Prevention of Corruption Act and Companies Act
Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (FEMA) and Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 (PMLA)
e: Enforcement Directorate (ED) mukhya roop se do kanoon lagu karta hai - Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (FEMA) jismein videshi mudra (foreign exchange) ke niyam ke ullanghan par karyavahi hoti hai, aur Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 (PMLA) jismein kaale dhan ko safed (launder) karne ke mamle mein sakshya (evidence) jama karke sampatti (properties) kunji (attach) ki jaati hain. Competition Act/IBC, Customs/Central Excise aur Prevention of Corruption Act/Companies Act - ye anya sansthon ke kshetra hain (jaise CCI, CBIC, CVC/SFIO). ED ki jaanch PMLA ke teht sakshya (ED attaches) aur videsh ekaaiyon (foreign agencies) se sahyog par nirbhar hai. Exam point: ED = FEMA (1999) + PMLA (2002) ke teht karyavahi karta hai; ye Vitt Mantralaya ke aadhin hai.

qe: Under the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013, what proportion of members of the Lokpal must be from a judicial background?
qh: लोकपाल और लोकायुक्त अधिनियम, 2013 के तहत लोकपाल के कितने प्रतिशत सदस्य न्यायिक पृष्ठभूमि से होने चाहिए?
o: At least 50% (half of the total members)
At least 25% of the total members
e: Lokpal aur Lokayuktas Act, 2013 ke anusaar Lokpal ke sadasyaon mein kam se kam 50% (aadhe) sadasya nyayik prishthbhumi (judicial background) ke honge - yahi vyavastha Lokpal ki nishpakshata aur kanooni samajh (legal understanding) banaye rakhne ke liye hai; iske alava Lokpal ke adhyaksh bhi nyayadhish ya prashiddh vyakti ho sakte hain. Baaki sadasya bhrashtachar rokne, vittiya (finance) shaasan aur vigyapan (vigilance) ke kshetra se aate hain, aur adhiktam 8 sadasya hote hain (adhiktam 50% hi judicial honge - yani aadhe se kam nahi). 'No quota', '25%' ya '100%' wale vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Lokpal = kam se kam 50% sadasya judicial prishthbhumi ke (Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013).

qe: Under which environmental legislation was the Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (WCCB) constituted as a statutory multidisciplinary agency?
qh: वन्यजीव अपराध नियंत्रण ब्यूरो (WCCB) का गठन किस पर्यावरण कानून के तहत किया गया था?
e: Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (WCCB) ko Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972 ke teht 2007 mein banaya gaya - ye ek bahu-vishayak (multidisciplinary) statutory agency hai jo vanjeevon (wildlife) ki traficking, avaidh shikar aur angon ke vyapar (trade in body parts) ki jaanch ke liye banayi gayi, aur ismein van, police, customs aur anya sansthon ke adhikari shaamil hote hain. Forest (Conservation) Act 1980, Environment (Protection) Act 1986 aur Biological Diversity Act 2002 anya paryavaran niyam hain, par WCCB ka aadhar 1972 wala Wild Life Act hi hai. Iska mukhyaalay Delhi mein hai aur ye Paryavaran, Van aur Jalvayu Parivartan Mantralaya ke aadhin hai. Exam point: WCCB = Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972 ke teht, 2007 mein sthapit; wildlife aparadhon ki jaanch agency.

qe: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) acts as the premier anti-smuggling intelligence agency under which regulatory board?
qh: राजस्व खुफिया निदेशालय (DRI) किस विनियामक बोर्ड के तहत प्रमुख तस्करी-रोधी खुफिया एजेंसी के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC), Ministry of Finance
e: Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) kendra Vitta Mantralaya (Ministry of Finance) ke teht aane wale Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ke aadhin kaam karne wali pramukh (premier) smuggling-vichakshu (anti-smuggling) agency hai - ye seema-shulk (customs) aur abhiyojya-shulk se juda aapraadh, jaise sona, nshile padarth (narcotics), nakli saamaan aur vyapaarik dhokha ki jaanch karti hai. SEBI, ED aur CBDT alag-alag kshetraon ke sansthaan hain (SEBI securities, ED FEMA/PMLA, CBDT direct tax) - inse DRI ka sambandh nahi hai. Exam point: DRI = CBIC (Vitt Mantralaya) ke aadhin anti-smuggling intelligence agency; customs dhokhon ka mukhya jaanch.

qe: Under the Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006, how many functional Standing Committees must every Gram Panchayat constitute?
qh: बिहार पंचायत राज अधिनियम, 2006 के तहत प्रत्येक ग्राम पंचायत को कितनी स्थायी समितियां गठित करनी होती हैं?
o: 6 Committees (Planning, Production, Social Justice, Education, Public Health, Public Works)
e: Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006 ke anusaar pratyek Gram Panchayat mein 6 karyarat (functional) Standing Committees banana zaroori hai - (1) Planning, (2) Production, (3) Social Justice, (4) Education, (5) Public Health aur (6) Public Works; inke adhyaksh mukhiya ya unke dwara naamit sadasya hote hain aur ye vibhag-sambandhi (sectoral) yojnaon ki nigrani karti hain. 4 ya 8 committees wale vikalp Bihar vidhi ke aankdon se mel nahi khaate, aur 'fixed 3 councils' ka koi pravdhan nahi hai. Yahi 6 committee wali vyavastha Bihar ke panchayati raj ka ek khaas lakshan hai. Exam point: Bihar Gram Panchayat = 6 Standing Committees (Planning, Production, Social Justice, Education, Public Health, Public Works).

qe: Who statutorily serves as the ex-officio Chairman of the Social Justice Standing Committee in a Gram Panchayat in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में ग्राम पंचायत की सामाजिक न्याय स्थायी समिति का पदेन अध्यक्ष कौन होता है?
e: Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006 ke anusaar Gram Panchayat ke Social Justice Standing Committee ke ex-officio adhyaksh (Chairman) Up-Mukhiya hote hain - yani Gram Panchayat ke up-sarpanch. Ye committee samaajik nyay (social justice) se jude kaam, jaise SC/ST aur picchde vargon ke yojnaon ki nigrani, samaajik samrasta aur kalyan karyakram dekhti hai. Mukhiya Panchayat ke pramukh hote hain aur wo anya committee ki vyavastha dekh sakte hain, Block Development Officer (BDO) ek sarkari padadhikari hai jo Panchayat ko sahyog deta hai, aur nominated member kisi standing committee ka ex-officio adhyaksh nahi hota. Exam point: Social Justice Standing Committee ka adhyaksh = Up-Mukhiya (Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006).

qe: Under which constitutional sub-clause of Article 243-D are State Legislatures empowered to provide reservation for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) in Panchayats?
qh: अनुच्छेद 243-D के किस उप-खंड के तहत राज्य विधानमंडलों को पंचायतों में अन्य पिछड़े वर्गों (OBC) के लिए आरक्षण का प्रावधान करने का अधिकार है?
e: Article 243-D ke vibhinn up-vakya (sub-clauses) alag-alag mamlon ke liye hain - 243-D(1) SC/ST ke liye aarakshan, 243-D(2) unke liye adhyaksh pad ka aarakshan, 243-D(3) mahilaon ke liye ek-tihai aarakshan, aur 243-D(6) raajya vidhan mandalon ko adhikar deta hai ki wo anya picchde vargon (OBC, jaise Bihar mein) ke liye panchayaton mein aarakshan ka pravdhan kanoon dwara kar sake. Isliye OBC aarakshan ka aadhar 243-D(6) hai; 243-T(2) sangha kshetraon (UTs) ke liye panchayaton ka pravdhan hai, aur baaki up-vakya ka sawaal alag hai. Exam point: panchayat mein OBC aarakshan = Article 243-D(6) (rajya vidhan mandal kanoon se), mahila aarakshan = 243-D(3).

qe: What is the mandatory advance public notice period required for convening an ordinary meeting of the Gram Sabha in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में ग्राम सभा की साधारण बैठक बुलाने के लिए कितने दिन की पूर्व सार्वजनिक सूचना देना अनिवार्य है?
e: Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006 ke anusaar Gram Sabha ki samanya (ordinary) baithak bulane ke liye kam se kam 7 spasht (clear) din ki purv-soochna (prior notice) dena zaroori hai - is 'clear days' ka matlab hai ki notice lagane ke din aur baithak wale din ko ginti se bahar rakh kar poore 7 din milne chahiye, taaki gaon ke logon ko samay par pata chal sake aur wo apni bat rakh sakein. 30, 15 ya 3 din wale vikalp kanoon ke aankdon se mel nahi khaate (Bihar mein 7 clear days ka niyam hai). Gram Sabha samay-samay par vishesh baithak bhi kar sakti hai, jismein alag niyam ho sakte hain. Exam point: Gram Sabha samanya baithak ki soochna = 7 clear days (Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006).

qe: What is the population threshold defined under the Bihar Municipal Act for declaring an urban area as a 'Nagar Parishad' (Municipal Council)?
qh: बिहार नगरपालिका अधिनियम के तहत किसी शहरी क्षेत्र को 'नगर परिषद' घोषित करने के लिए जनसंख्या सीमा क्या है?
e: Bihar Nagar Palika (Municipal) Adhiniyam ke anusaar aise shahri (urban) kshetra ko 'Nagar Parishad' (Municipal Council) ghoshit kiya jaata hai jiski jansankhya 40,000 se 2,00,000 ke beech ho - isse chhoti jansankhya wale kshetra 'Nagar Panchayat' (Town Area) ke roop mein aate hain (jaise 12,000 se 40,000) aur 2 lakh se badi aabadi wale kshetra 'Nagar Nigam' (Municipal Corporation) ki seema mein aate hain. Isliye '10,000 se kam', '12,000-40,000' aur '2 lakh se upar' wale vikalp alag-alag sansthon (Nagar Panchayat/Nagar Nigam) ke aankde hain. Exam point: Nagar Parishad = 40,000 se 2,00,000 jansankhya (Bihar Municipal Act); Nagar Panchayat se chhota, Nigam se bada.

qe: What minimum educational qualification is statutorily mandated for appointing a 'Nyay Mitra' to assist the Gram Katchery in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में ग्राम कचहरी की सहायता के लिए 'न्याय मित्र' की नियुक्ति हेतु कौन सी न्यूनतम शैक्षणिक योग्यता अनिवार्य है?
o: Degree in Law (LL.B.) from a recognized institution
e: Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006 ke anusaar Gram Katchery (Gram Kachahri) mein sahayak (assist) karne ke liye 'Nyay Mitra' ki niyukti ke liye kanoon mein digri (LL.B.) - yani kisi manyata prapt (recognized) sanstha se vidhi (law) ki padvi - ka hona zaroori hai. Isse gaon ke logon ko unke mamlon mein kanooni samajh aur sulah-samjhauta (mediation) mein madad milti hai; Nyay Mitra sanyukt (joint) roop se Nyayadhish Panch ki madad karta hai. 10+2, samajshastra ki B.A. ya rural development ka diploma is pad ke liye niyam mein nahi hai. Exam point: Gram Katchery ka Nyay Mitra = law graduate (LL.B.) hona zaroori (Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006).

qe: Who is statutorily empowered to divide a Gram Panchayat into territorial Wards in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में ग्राम पंचायत को क्षेत्रीय वार्डों में विभाजित करने का वैधानिक अधिकार किसके पास है?
o: The Mukhiya in Gram Sabha consultation
e: Bihar mein kisi Gram Panchayat ko kshetriya wardon (territorial wards) mein baantne (divide) ka adhikar Zila Adhikari (District Magistrate / Collector) ke paas hota hai - wo gaon ki aabadi aur suvidha ke hisaab se wardon ka naksha (map) tay karte hain, taaki harek ward se panch ka chunav ho sake. Mukhiya, Gram Sabha ya Block Development Officer khud se ward ka baantna nahi kar sakte; SEC (State Election Commissioner) chunav ki prakriya dekhta hai par ward ki sima ye DM/Collector tay karte hain (vidhi ke teht). Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006 ke anusaar ye karyavahi pradhan (notification) ke saath hoti hai. Exam point: Gram Panchayat ke ward ka bantwara = District Magistrate (Collector), Bihar Panchayat Raj Act 2006 ke teht.

qe: Who functions as the administrative Executive Officer (E.O.) in a Nagar Parishad in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में नगर परिषद में प्रशासनिक कार्यपालक पदाधिकारी (E.O.) के रूप में कौन कार्य करता है?
o: A State administrative cadre officer appointed by the Urban Development and Housing Department
e: Nagar Parishad (Municipal Council) mein Nagar Panchalak Adhikari (Executive Officer - E.O.) ke roop mein rajya prashasnik seva (State administrative cadre) ka ek adhikari hota hai, jise Nagar Vikas aur Aavas Vibhag (Urban Development and Housing Department) niyukt karta hai - ye Parishad ke nitinirnay (policy decisions) ko lagu karne, staff ka prabandh aur sarkari karyavahi chalane ka kaam dekhta hai. Chunavi (elected) Adhyaksh (Municipal President) Parishad ka rajnitik (political) pramukh hota hai, District Collector ex-officio adhyaksh nahi hote, aur police adhikari ka is prabandhan mein koi role nahi hai. Exam point: Nagar Parishad ka Executive Officer = state cadre ka adhikari, Urban Development and Housing Department dwara niyukt.

qe: Under the Provisions of the Panchayats (Extension to the Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996 (PESA), who holds the mandatory authority over minor forest produce and local dispute management in Fifth Schedule areas?
qh: PESA अधिनियम 1996 के तहत पांचवीं अनुसूची के क्षेत्रों में लघु वनोपज और स्थानीय विवादों पर अनिवार्य अधिकार किसे प्राप्त है?
e: PESA (Panchayats Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996 ke teht panchvin (Fifth) anusuchi wale kshetraon mein chhote van-upaj (minor forest produce) par haq, zameen ka surakshan (land record), aabadi ke vivad (disputes) ka niptan aur nadi-jal ke mamlon mein anivarya (mandatory) adhikar Gram Sabha ke paas hota hai - yahi PESA ki buniyaadi (core) baat hai, jo aadiwasiyon (tribals) ko apne sansadhan aur mamlon par niyantran deti hai. Zila Parishad ki forest committee, SDM, ya State Forest Development Corporation ko ye 'mandatory' adhikar nahi diya gaya hai; isliye PESA kshetraon mein Gram Sabha ki salah/sehmati ke bina aise mamlon par faisla nahi ho sakta. Exam point: PESA (1996) = minor forest produce aur local vivadon par Gram Sabha ka anivarya adhikar (Fifth Schedule areas).

qe: Under Article 243-ZD, what minimum proportion of the members of a District Planning Committee (DPC) must be elected representatives?
qh: अनुच्छेद 243-ZD के तहत जिला योजना समिति (DPC) के न्यूनतम कितने सदस्य निर्वाचित जनप्रतिनिधि होने चाहिए?
e: Article 243-ZD ke anusaar District Planning Committee (DPC) ke kul sadasyaon mein se kam se kam chaar-panch (4/5) hissa chunavi (elected) pratinidhi hone chahiye - yani zila parishad aur nagar palikaon ke chune hue sadasya, taaki zile ki yojna (plan) janta ke pratinidhiyon dwara banayi jaye. Baaki sadasya (adhiktam 1/5) adhikari, visheshagy ya anya log ho sakte hain. 'Two-thirds', 'half' ya 'three-fourths' wale aankde minak (low) hain; samvidhan ne 4/5 ka pravdhan rakha hai. DPC apne zila ki panchayaton aur nagar palikaon ki yojnaon ko milakar draft vikas yojna banati hai. Exam point: DPC ka 4/5 hissa elected representatives hona zaroori (Article 243-ZD); yahi zila yojna ka aadhar banata hai.

qe: What is the maximum criminal fine that a Gram Katchery can impose under the Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006?
qh: बिहार पंचायत राज अधिनियम, 2006 के तहत ग्राम कचहरी अधिकतम कितना आपराधिक जुर्माना लगा सकती है?
e: Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006 ke anusaar Gram Katchery (Gram Kachahri) kisi bhi aparadh par adhiktam Rs 1,000 tak ka jurya (fine) laga sakti hai - ye chhote-jhagde aur gaon ke dayre ke mamlon ke liye ek sasti aur tez nyay-vyavastha hai, jahan Nyayadhish Panch (nyay ke panch) aur unke sahayak Nyay Mitra sunte hain. Bade mamle aur bhari jurya ke adhikar Civil Court/nyayalay ke paas hain; Gram Katchery 'Rs 10,000', 'Rs 5,000' ya 'Rs 250' ke aankdon mein nahi chal sakti. Jo vikalp bade aankde dikhate hain wo galat hain kyunki Gram Katchery ki sakti seemit (limited) hai. Exam point: Gram Katchery ka adhiktam jurya = Rs 1,000 (Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006).

qe: Under the updated election system in Bihar introduced in 2022, how are the Mayor and Deputy Mayor of Municipal Corporations elected?
qh: 2022 से लागू व्यवस्था के अनुसार बिहार में नगर निगमों के महापौर (मेयर) और उप-महापौर का चुनाव कैसे होता है?
o: Nominated by the State Urban Development Minister
Directly by the registered voters of the entire city
Indirectly by the elected Ward Councillors
Elected by rotation among ward committees
e: Bihar mein 2022 mein chunav vyavastha (election system) mein sudhar (change) ke baad Nagar Nigam (Municipal Corporation) ke Mahanagar Adhyaksh (Mayor) aur Upa-Mahanagar Adhyaksh (Deputy Mayor) ka chunav seedhe taur par poore shehar ke panjikrit matdata (registered voters) dwara hota hai - yani janta seedha apna Mayor chunti hai, na ki vard parishad ke counsillors (ward councillors) usse chunte hain. Isse Mayor ko janta ki seedhi janadesh (mandate) milti hai. 'Rajya Mantri dwara nominated', 'ward councillors dwara indirect chunav' aur 'rotation' wale vikalp Bihar ki nayi vyavastha se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: Bihar mein (2022 se) Mayor aur Deputy Mayor ka seedha chunav janta (registered voters) dwara.

qe: What is the quorum requirement for holding an official meeting of the Gram Sabha in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में ग्राम सभा की आधिकारिक बैठक आयोजित करने के लिए आवश्यक कोरम क्या है?
o: One-twentieth (1/20th) of the total membership of the Gram Sabha
e: Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006 ke anusaar Gram Sabha ki aadhikarik baithak ke liye quorum (ganpoorak sankhya) ke roop mein kul sadasyaon ki ek-beesvin (1/20) hissa sadasyon ka maujood hona zaroori hai; itni sankhya poore na hone par baithak ki karyavahi nahi ho sakti aur nayi taareekh par phir se soochna dekar baithak bulani padti hai. '1/10 voters', '100 vyakti' ya '1/3 voters' wale vikalp Bihar ke niyam se mel nahi khaate - kanoon mein 1/20 ka aankda hi likha hai. Iska maksad yahi hai ki Gram Sabha ka faisla gaon ke sadasyaon ki vastavik bhaagidaari se ho, keval thode logon ki upasthiti se nahi. Exam point: Gram Sabha ka quorum = kul sadasyata ka 1/20 hissa (Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006).

qe: Which Article bars courts from interfering in electoral matters regarding delimitation and election conduct of Panchayats?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद न्यायालयों को पंचायतों के परिसीमन और चुनाव संचालन में हस्तक्षेप करने से रोकता है?
e: Article 243-O (aur sangha kshetraon ke liye 243-ZG) ke anusaar panchayaton ke chunav, sima-nirdharan (delimitation) aur chunav-sambandhi mamlon mein nyayalay (court) hastakshep nahi kar sakte - yani chunav ki prakriya rajya nirvachan aayog (State Election Commission) ke haath mein hai aur uske aadesh par court ka ruka (stay) nahi lagta. Article 243-K rajya nirvachan aayukta (State Election Commissioner) ki niyukti/hataye ke bare mein hai, aur Article 329A sansad ke chunav ke mamlon se juda purana pravdhan hai. Isliye panchayat chunav ke mamlon mein sahi pravdhan 243-O hai (panchayat ke liye), 243-ZG sangha kshetraon ke liye samantar vyavastha. Exam point: panchayat chunav ke mamlon mein court ka hastakshep nahi - Article 243-O (UT/municipal ke liye 243-ZG).

qe: What was the landmark recommendation of the L.M. Singhvi Committee (1986) concerning Panchayati Raj institutions?
qh: पंचायती राज संस्थाओं के संबंध में एल.एम. सिंघवी समिति (1986) की ऐतिहासिक सिफारिश क्या थी?
o: Transferring local administration directly to District Collectors
Replacing village panchayats with corporate farming cooperatives
Constitutional recognition, protection, and preservation of Panchayats by adding a new chapter to the Constitution
e: L.M. Singhvi Committee (1986) ne sabse bada sujhav yahi diya ki panchayati raj sansthaon ko samvidhanik manyata (constitutional recognition) dili jaye aur samvidhan mein ek naya adhyay (chapter) jod kar unhe surakshit aur sanrakshit (protected) kiya jaye - yahi sujhav aage chal kar 73th (1992) samvidhan sanshodhan aur Part IX ka aadhar bana. Iske alava is committee ne gaon panchayat ko 'gram sabha' ke roop mein mazbut (strong) karne, panchayaton ke chunav ke liye alag nirvachan aayog aur panchayaton ke kaam ke liye nyayik punaravalokan (judicial review) se suraksha jaise sujhav bhi diye. Zila adhikariyon ko saari satta dena, corporate cooperatives ya block councils khatm karne wale sujhav is committee ke nahi the. Exam point: L.M. Singhvi Committee (1986) = panchayati raj ko samvidhanik manyata (naya adhyay) dene ki sifarish - 73th sanshodhan ki neev.

qe: Under Article 243-E, if a Panchayat is dissolved prematurely, for what duration does the newly elected reconstituted Panchayat serve?
qh: अनुच्छेद 243-E के तहत, यदि कोई पंचायत समय से पहले भंग हो जाती है, तो नव-निर्वाचित पंचायत किस अवधि तक कार्य करती है?
o: Until the next state assembly elections
Only for the remainder of the period for which the dissolved Panchayat would have continued
A fresh full term of 5 years
e: Article 243-E ke anusaar agar koi Panchayat samay se pehle bhang (dissolve) kar di jaati hai, to uske baad chuni gayi nayin (reconstituted) Panchayat apna poora kaaryakal (fresh 5 saal) nahi paati - wo keval us samay-sima (remainder of period) tak kaam karti hai jitne ke liye purani bhang Panchayat rehti (would have continued), ye nayi kai sthiti mein 5 saal ke andar ka samay hota hai. Haan, agar bhang-kal (dissolution) ka samay 6 mahine se kam bacha ho to naye chunav karana zaroori nahi hota. 'Nayi 5 saal ki avadhi' ya '3 saal' wale vikalp samvidhan ke pravdhan se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: bhang panchayat ke baad nayi panchayat = purani avadhi ka shesh (remainder) samay hi (Article 243-E).

qe: Under Article 243-K(2), on what grounds and manner can the State Election Commissioner be removed from office?
qh: अनुच्छेद 243-K(2) के तहत राज्य निर्वाचन आयुक्त को उनके पद से किन आधारों और किस प्रक्रिया द्वारा हटाया जा सकता है?
o: By the Governor on the direct written advice of the Chief Minister
Through a simple resolution of the State Legislative Council
By an order of the Chief Election Commissioner of India
Only in like manner and on the like grounds as a Judge of a High Court (parliamentary removal)
e: 'Rajya Nirvachan Aayukta (State Election Commissioner) ki hataye kis tarah hoti hai?' - Article 243-K(2) ke anusaar unhe utne hi aadhar par aur usi tarah hataya ja sakta hai jaise High Court ke judge ko hataya jaata hai (parliamentary removal) - yani Rashtrapati ka aadesh, jismein sansad ke dono sadanon ki vishesh bahumat (special majority) aur judge ke durvyavhar (misbehaviour) ya ashaktata (incapacity) ka aarop hai. Mukhya mantri ki salah, rajya vidhan parishad ka prastav ya CEC ka aadesh unhe hatane ka aadhar nahi hai. Isi swatantrata (independence) ke karan panchayat chunav nishpaksh (impartial) roop se karaye ja sakte hain. Exam point: State Election Commissioner ki hataye = High Court judge ke samaan prakriya (Article 243-K(2)).

qe: Under Article 243-ZD, what is the core functional responsibility of the District Planning Committee (DPC)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 243-ZD के तहत जिला योजना समिति (DPC) का मुख्य कार्यात्मक दायित्व क्या है?
o: Conducting annual financial audits of commercial banks
Consolidating development plans prepared by Panchayats and Municipalities in the district and preparing a comprehensive draft development plan for the district as a whole
Managing police postings across rural blocks
e: Article 243-ZD ke anusaar District Planning Committee (DPC) ka mukhya kaam zile ki panchayaton aur nagar palikaon (Municipalities) dwara taiyaar ki gayi yojnaon ko ek jagah milana (consolidate) aur poore zile ke liye ek sammilit (comprehensive) draft vikas yojna banani hai - jismein sansadhan (resources), samaajik (social), aarthik (economic) aur saansadhanik (infrastructural) vikas ki baaten hoti hain, aur is yojna ko rajya sarkar ke paas bheja jaata hai. Bankon ka audit, zameen ka lagaan wasooli ya police postings DPC ka kaam nahi hai - ye vitta sansthon, rajya sarkar aur police adhikariyon ke kaam hain. Exam point: DPC = panchayat aur municipal yojnaon ka samanvay + zile ki sammilit vikas yojna ka draft (Article 243-ZD).

qe: Under Article 243-M, the provisions of Part IX (73rd Amendment) do NOT apply to which of the following States?
qh: अनुच्छेद 243-M के तहत भाग IX (73वां संशोधन) के प्रावधान किन राज्यों पर लागू नहीं होते हैं?
o: Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Madhya Pradesh
e: Article 243-M ke anusaar samvidhan ke Part IX (73th sanshodhan wale pravdhan) ka vistar (extension) aadiwasi (tribal) bahul rajyaon - Nagaland, Meghalaya aur Mizoram - par nahi hota, kyunki in rajyaon ki apni paramparik aadiwasi pranaliyan (customs) hain aur unke gaon/kshetra apni vyavastha chalate hain; isi tarah kuchh anya kshetra bhi is se bahar rakhe gaye hain. Bihar, UP, MP, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Kerala aur Tamil Nadu samanya rajya hain jahan Part IX lagu hota hai, isliye unke naam sahi nahi hain. Ye pravdhan Part IX ke saath Part IXA (nagarpalika) wale Article 243-ZC mein bhi milta-julta hai. Exam point: Part IX ka vistar nahi = Nagaland, Meghalaya, Mizoram (Article 243-M); sangha kshetraon ke liye bhi kuchh chhoot.

qe: Who served as the very first State Election Commissioner of Bihar following the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act?
qh: 73वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम के बाद बिहार के पहले राज्य निर्वाचन आयुक्त के रूप में किसने कार्य किया?
e: 73th samvidhan sanshodhan ke baad Bihar mein panchayati raj ke chunav karane ke liye jo pehle Rajya Nirvachan Aayukta (State Election Commissioner) niyukt hua, wo N.B. Lohani the - unke kaaryakal (1993 ke aas-paas) mein hi rajya mein panchayat chunav ki nayi vyavastha shuru hui thi. R.R. Diwakar aur Jairamdas Daulatram to Bihar ke purane Rajyapal (Governor) the, koi anya naam is pad se juda nahi hai. Rajya Nirvachan Aayukta ki niyukti Rajyapal karte hain aur unki swatantrata (independence) Article 243-K(2) se surakshit hoti hai. Exam point: 73th sanshodhan ke baad Bihar ke pehle Rajya Nirvachan Aayukta = N.B. Lohani (Rajyapal dwara niyukt, 243-K ke teht).
